title_en: Get Up, Tinka, Light the Pine Torch
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: The lines 'да не ти грешам коланот' and 'мојот се ѓердан, лудо, познава' are my reading (mistake the belt, you know my whole necklace); 'не ти влезам' is guessed as 'enter your house'.

words_to_learn.en: pine splinter used as a torch

lines.en: Get up, Tinka, light the pine torch,

lines.cyr: да не ти влезам Тинке в' темнина.
lines.lat: da ne ti vlezam Tinke v' temnina.
lines.en: so that I do not enter you, Tinka, in the dark.

lines.cyr: Јас ќе си земам, Тинке, елекот,
lines.lat: Jas ḱe si zemam, Tinke, elekot,
lines.en: I will take my vest, Tinka,

lines.cyr: да не ти грешам Тинке коланот.
lines.lat: da ne ti grešam Tinke kolanot.
lines.en: so that I do not mistake, Tinka, the belt.

lines.cyr: Јас ќе си земам, Тинке, појасот,
lines.lat: Jas ḱe si zemam, Tinke, pojasot,
lines.en: I will take my sash, Tinka,

lines.cyr: да не ти грешам Тинке ѓерданот.
lines.lat: da ne ti grešam Tinke ǵerdanot.
lines.en: so that I do not mistake, Tinka, the necklace.

lines.cyr: - Влези си, лудо море, земи си
lines.lat: - Vlezi si, ludo more, zemi si
lines.en: - Come in, hey silly one, take
my whole necklace, silly one, you know.
As many pebbles, silly one, as lie on the ground,

lines.cyr: толку е сребро лудо на него.
lines.lat: tolku e srebro ludo na nego.
lines.en: that much silver, silly one, is on it.
Get up, Tinka, light the pine torch,

lines.cyr: да не ти влезам в' темнина.
lines.lat: da ne ti vlezam v' temnina.
lines.en: so that I do not enter you in the dark.
